payload.reason: The evidence indicates that PARENT correlates better with human judgments compared to other text generation metrics, particularly in scenarios where reference texts diverge from the generated content.

claims.text: PARENT correlates with human judgments better than existing text generation metrics, especially when references diverge.
Both variants of PARENT show significantly better correlation with human judgments compared to other metrics across various settings.
PARENT performs best for semantic aspects of generated text, while BLEU excels in grammaticality and fluency.
